title: 3 cues for every 1v1 (coach content)
blueprint: Community coach content creation: 'content that doubles as content for coaches' (JDOs, clubs, hit list)
goal: Give club coaches something useful; keeps Fluid front of mind with clubs/JDOs

shots.vo: Coaches: three cues we use in every one-on-one rep.
One: eyes up. Read the defender, not the ball.
Two: win the hip. Get your shoulder past theirs.
Three: finish on balance. Rushed is not fast.
Simple cues players can actually use live.
